The first acquired-image control replay completed successfully: OASIS 11-to-12 final forward/reverse coordinates and validity arrays are byte-identical to the historical selected control already reproduced by P01/P02. It records 30 events and 13 captured states, with 20 accepted coarse updates and zero accepted fine updates followed by six rejected fine attempts. Independent artifact verification passes with no failures: event/counter/objective continuity, saved-record identity, raw dimensions/hashes and all eight final checkpoint/map/warped/validity metadata artifacts matching the ordinary final export. Diagnostic wall time was 1,874 s and peak child RSS about 5.09 GiB; checkpoint overhead excludes this from production performance evidence.

After these gates passed, froze execution-parallel-v1 for precisely the nine remaining declared case/policy replays. This prospective operational amendment uses two independent jobs, each retaining one Java processor, a 6 GiB heap and the original one-hour deadline. All numerical classes, data, saved affines, policy flags, capture points and geometry thresholds remain those of trajectories-v1. The amendment records the original protocol/seal and pilot evidence hashes and separate dispatcher sources; every subsequent receipt records the amendment identity and forbids runtime comparison. No fitting/selection policy changed. The diagnostic queue is launched; the pilot's first checkpoint score is being verified before running the remaining checkpoint audits.
